# MatrixQR Blog
> The official technical blog of MatrixQR — a privacy-first, client-side QR code generator. We publish deep dives on offline QR generation, WiFi/vCard security, and privacy-by-design tooling.

- [Static vs Dynamic QR Codes: Which One Suits Your Business?](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/static-vs-dynamic-qr)
- [Convert Menu Images to QR Codes Instantly: A Simple Guide for Restaurants](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/image-to-qr-menu-guide)

- [ALL Blog](https://blog.matrixqr.cc/posts/)
